gaps.why_now: The dedicated Phase 9 build step is the smallest honest review gate for runtime pilot-module work.
The survey gate keeps the roadmap anchor and remaining runtime-substrate blockers explicit while the lane is still narrow.
A sample-backed lifecycle starter is the first honest runtime-facing step that can reuse existing atomic helpers without pretending the full module substrate already exists.
A dedicated Phase 9 test file keeps the starter sample reviewable and bounded around lifecycle transitions plus the selftest-facing atomic64 surface.

A narrow differential gate now captures selected atomic64_test.c expectations for wide-value exchange and cmpxchg behavior, bounded guard paths (`add_unless`, `inc_not_zero`, and `dec_if_positive`), plus selftest-family coverage before any broader runtime substrate work.
A future loadable handoff inside the runtime sample family still depends on runtime substrate pieces that the repo has not started yet.
